scope: Local production frontend; provider/indexer/wallet fixtures only. No new live claim, wallet proof, transaction or publication.
change: Destination, epoch, vault-discovery and input-resolution reads have a 15-second deadline before submitting a claim or requesting a financial wallet transaction. The noncommitting addressed-claim simulation also has this deadline. Permanent recovery verification retains its existing read deadlines.

verification.beforeFix: The guest epoch regression timed out rather than rejecting at the read deadline. Against the preceding production build, the receiving-account browser regression kept Collecting disabled after the deadline. Its first locator attempt was corrected to follow the changing busy label before measuring the actual old failure.
verification.client: All 174 tests /19 files PASS. Seven new tests cover guest destination/epoch/vault/input stalls, addressed proof input/simulation stalls and a deliberately slow broadcast.
verification.browser: 94 reader/delivery/postbox-claim desktop/mobile checks PASS with one Windows CI worker (1.2 minutes).

results: Timed-out preparation stops before reserving an attempt or broadcasting, even when the losing read later resolves.
Addressed input/simulation stalls occur after one synthetic ownership approval; a late result cannot submit that proof.
The guest UI retains its letter, destination and separate review, releases controls and permits an explicit change or retry; the late read triggers no write or journal entry.

Financial wallet requests, signing and actual consensus submission do not use this read deadline. A broadcast deliberately held beyond it remains uncertain in the original journal and later completes that same attempt.
limits: Underlying read/simulation requests may finish in the background; no HTTP cancellation is claimed.
This is a per-preparation-step deadline, not a whole-operation deadline.
A recipient may need to explicitly authorize a new ownership proof after a preparation failure. No financial claim was submitted by that failed preparation.
Latest preparation behavior is fixture verified. Earlier real stock/guest acceptance atc12b047 and funded/hosted evidence keep their exact separate scopes.
Human retains GitHub push and publication control.
